title: Anthropic's $81.3 billion IPO is the largest ever; shares open at $111.50 on the Nasdaq
lesson: the company is the subject, never the exchange building

title: Utah visits TCU, close to Big 12 title game
body: No. 2 Utah comes to Fort Worth.
lesson: a football story wants the stadium, not a campus chapel

title: Northwest ISD approves revised high school boundaries after parents speak out
lesson: a district's own schools first; buses only as the institution fallback

title: Largest enrollment drop in Texas' recorded history means challenges for public schools, Morath says
lesson: 'Morath says' is attribution, not the subject

title: Cooper Flagg scores 33 as Mavs keep Warriors winless since Curry's injury
lesson: the team's arena stands in for a player

title: Cowboys strip play-calling duties from defensive coordinator Christian Parker
lesson: a coaching decision is about the coordinator: search for him, never the team's stadium (library.venue_fits)

title: Voters will likely decide Dallas City Hall's future in May election
lesson: another city's landmark is searched for, never swapped for ours

title: Fort Worth police set new policies for Flock cameras
lesson: a police department is depicted by the police beat

title: Grand Theft Auto VI is out today on PS5 and Xbox
lesson: a game is depicted by the gaming beat (controllers), never a skyline

title: These are the 14 best things to do in Fort Worth this weekend
body: Ice skating is back in the Stockyards.
lesson: no named subject: the city itself is fine

title: Tarrant County jail death under investigation
lesson: a county name alone is a place, the jail beat applies

title: Trinity Metro board approves cuts to On-Demand service
lesson: the agency's own buses and station

title: Women's Funkytown Showdown at Dickies Arena, Sun, Nov 22 12:00 PM
lesson: punctuation ends a name; the venue is a building, never another artist's show

title: Ty Myers: The Legal Tour 2026 at Dickies Arena
lesson: the performer and the venue are two subjects; a colon ends the first

title: Parade of Lights rolls through downtown Fort Worth this Sunday
lesson: a generic event name needs the city in the file name: Lake Mead has a Parade of Lights too

title: One last love letter: San Antonio Zoo mourns Fiona, Timothy the hippo's longtime sweetheart
lesson: a zoo story's picture shows the animal in the headline, never an inspection of another animal

title: Austin weekend: Theater performances, Bastrop B-day
lesson: a lone common noun after a colon is not a subject: 'Theater' found a Minneapolis theater

title: Why fall foliage looks different across South Central Texas
lesson: a region is a place, not a subject: searching it found a storm satellite image

title: Sarkisian hopes to send Texas seniors out in style against Arkansas
lesson: an opponent named by its state is a place, not a subject: 'Arkansas' found a landscape

title: Dallas Cowboys mark 30 years of giving back with Salvation Army
body: The Dallas Cowboys celebrated 30 years of partnership with the Salvation Army by serving early Thanksgiving meals at facilities in Dallas and Fort Worth.
lesson: Nov 21: a charity meal service is not a game at AT&T Stadium; the team's name reaches its stadium only for a game there

title: Kyrie Irving scores 25, Cooper Flagg 22 as the Mavericks top the Clippers 110-100
body: Kyrie Irving scored 25 points and Cooper Flagg had 22 points.
lesson: Nov 21: 'Mavericks' is the Dallas team (never OS X Mavericks, never the UTA Mavericks); a bare 'Clippers' is never searched

title: Senator Cruz launches Saving Texas to win back the State House and some Congressional seats in 2028
body: Following the blue wave election in Texas, U.S. Senator Ted Cruz pledges to recapture the State House and some Congressional seats for Republicans.
lesson: Nov 22: 'Congressional' is an adjective, not a subject (it found an unnamed congressman); 'Senator Cruz' is searched as the full name the story gives

title: College football grades: Texas earns 'A' for dominant win, Indiana gets 'D' on Week 12 report card
body: When Texas quarterback Arch Manning takes care of the football, it does wonders for his team's championship viability.
lesson: Nov 22: the letter grade 'D' was kept as a name and matched nearly every topic phrase; AT&T Stadium was drawn for a Longhorns win in Austin

title: Broncos Ring of Fame linebacker and Hall of Fame broadcaster Tom Jackson dies at 75
body: Denver Broncos legend and Ring of Fame linebacker Tom Jackson has died at the age of 75.
lesson: Nov 22: 'Hall of Fame' drew another man at a hall of fame induction for a story about Tom Jackson's death
